headline: N R Agarwal Industries appoints Makarand P Barhanpurkar as Senior Managerial Personnel
hook: New senior manager joins the team
summary: N R Agarwal Industries Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Makarand P Barhanpurkar as a Senior Managerial Personnel. The appointment takes effect from October 12, 2026. This is a routine managerial update filed by the company with the stock exchange. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap paper manufacturers should note this standard administrative update.
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no material impact on share price
